name: axis_dma_regs
desc: AXI-Stream DMA: start control, MM2S / S2MM address and length, status.

fields.name: MM2S_START
fields.desc: write 1: start a memory to stream transfer

fields.name: S2MM_START
fields.desc: write 1: start a stream to memory transfer

registers.name: MM2S_LEN
registers.desc: MM2S length in bytes (multiple of 4, not 0)

registers.name: S2MM_LEN
registers.desc: S2MM length in bytes (multiple of 4, not 0)

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: status; done and error bits write 1 to clear

fields.name: MM2S_ERR
fields.desc: MM2S bad length or bus error (W1C)

fields.name: S2MM_ERR
fields.desc: S2MM bad length or bus error (W1C)
